definitions: fixes (an object) firmly and deeply in a surrounding mass
inserts (a data file, graphic, etc.) into a document or program
integrates (an idea or feeling) into something else
assigns (a journalist) to report from within a military unit in a combat area
examples: The archaeologist embeds the artifact in plaster for protection.
The software embeds the video directly into the webpage.
The culture embeds strong family values.
The news organization embeds its reporters with the troops.
